item.description: Michael Douglas and Catherine Zeta-Jones enjoy their historic estate, S'Estaca, located in Mallorca. item.title: Washington captures record 2.16 million invasive green crabs, but experts warn invasion is far from over
item.description: Washington state removed more than 2.16 million invasive European green crabs during fiscal year 2025-26. First detected in the state in 2016, the species threatens native marine life, including clams, oysters and eelgrass. Despite more than $8 million in state funding, no established populations have been eradicated, and researchers warn the invasion could worsen. Fuente: The Times of India - World.

item.description: In 2011, Taylor Swift generously donated 6,000 books to bolster local libraries in Berks County amid looming budget cuts. This pivotal support allowed the Reading Public Library to enrich its programs and attract thousands of community members. By 2025, the library circulated over 182,000 items and continued to foster engagement through various initiatives, proving Swift’s contribution remains vital for the region's library services to this day. item.title: Scientists make cells from an 80-year-old donor appear young, advancing ageing research
item.description: Scientists have reprogrammed blood-cell precursors from an 80-year-old donor into neural stem cells with an epigenetic age below 20, according to a study published in Aging Cell. The process unfolded gradually over more than 100 days, offering researchers a way to investigate cellular rejuvenation and its potential implications for ageing and Alzheimer's research. item.description: El Solano, a captivating mansion nestled in Palm Beach, was acquired by music legend John Lennon and his partner Yoko Ono in 1980. Following Lennon’s untimely passing, Yoko executed extensive renovations before offloading the property in 1986. The illustrious estate changed hands several times, skyrocketing in value, and ultimately fetched $36 million in 2020.
